label: Landsat II programme contributor, 1977
basis: Named co-investigator in the New Zealand Landsat II programme’s September 1977 final report. The programme linked satellite observations with land-use, environmental, geological and forestry investigations.

sources.label: Ellis, Thomas and McDonnell (eds), Landsat II Investigation Programme, PEL Report 587, September 1977, affiliations p.9 and contents pp.10–13
